title: MENS Distributed Training & Execution Plan (2026-05-09)
summary: Distributed-AI track supplementing Mesh SSOT; defines 15 task IDs, model-loading/execution/training specs, content-addressed SafeTensors bundles, and MENS corpus alignment.
notes: Presented as a 'plan', but explicitly defines task IDs, struct/trait sketches, and acceptance gates that function as a technical specification for the MENS distributed-AI subsystem. Borderline between DOC and SPEC; classified as SPEC because it specifies contract boundaries and acceptance criteria.
